description: The result of a [`Command`], same variant.
title: Response

step.description: Recorded step (`None` for dry runs and edits that change nothing, D3).
The history step this mutation recorded; `None` for dry runs and no-op edits.

changed.description: Metric path → `[before, after]` (SI); `null` when absent on one side.

resolved_diagnostics.description: `<code>@<path>` keys of diagnostics that went away.

CheckDelta.description:
The post-edit check delta every mutating tool returns (S:86, I6; DA:118-123):

```json
{"status":"warnings","model_hash":"…","step":"s0004",
 "changed":{"stability.liftoff":[1.42,1.18],"mass.liftoff":[0.512,0.498]},
 "new_diagnostics":[{"code":"RW-E101","severity":"error","path":"/c/fins/span","message":"…","hint":"…"}],
 "resolved_diagnostics":["RW-W012@/c/body"]}
```

CheckStatus.description:
Overall status: `errors` if any error diagnostic or failed error-severity
assertion, else `warnings` if any warning, else `clean`.

path.description: JSON pointer into the source model, e.g. `/c/fins/span`.

Diagnostic.description: One finding, phrased for an agent (`hint` says what to do next).

model.description: The whole model, when `path` is empty.

value.description: The selected subtree, when `path` is set.

model_hash.description:
blake3 hex of the canonical evaluated model (D19a): comment and
formatting edits do not change it.

components.description: Components in tree order (depth-first from the root body component).

engines.description:
Liquid engines and their feed systems (`engines/<id>.rw.toml`), SI,
with tank nodes resolved against their `tank` components (M4.4).

units.description: SI unit symbol per dimension name used in this document (`length` → `m`).

Reference.description: Reference dimensions used by aero and stability.

oneOf.description: Pure number (ratios, counts, coefficients). Bare numbers allowed.

DimKind.description: A named physical dimension, as written in `x-unit-dimension`.

containment.description: How this component sits in its parent.

aero.description: Participates in aerodynamics (external axial chain + surface components).

x_fore.description: Fore station (m from the nose tip).

radial.description: Radial offset of the component axis from the body axis.

EvalComponent.description:
One placed component. Its kind (`shape.type`) and SI shape parameters
are in [`EvalShape`].

oneOf.description: Inside a tube: rings, inner tubes, recovery, mass.
On the outer surface: fins, lugs, buttons.

offset.description: Body-frame offset `[x, y, z]` of this instance from the component placement.

Appearance.description: Renderer appearance (R2.5). Presets map to PBR materials.

oneOf.description: Fields shared by the planar fin sets.
Fields shared by the planar fin sets.

points.description: Planform `[x, y]` from the root LE.

oneOf.description: Fields shared by the planar fin sets.

height.description: Total height above the body surface.

base_height.description:
Base height at the body surface (source default `height / 4`;
0 when absent from older evaluated JSON).

flange_height.description:
Flange height at the outer face (source default `height / 4`;
0 when absent from older evaluated JSON).

oneOf.description: A spool: base (od, at the body), neck (id), flange (od, outermost).

EvalShape.description:
Shape parameters in SI, tagged by `type` (same spelling as
[`super::ComponentType`]). Hollow parts carry `id`; solid parts have `id = 0`.

members.description: Member component ids (axial chain plus contents).

overrides.description: Whole-stage mass/CG override (members' dry parts, motors excluded).

motor.description: Motor ref as written (`generic:RW_C6G`); resolved by the Session.

import.description: Import provenance of the motor (absent for authored configurations).

accept_substitution.description: The substituted generic curve is accepted (no `RW-W103`).

digest.description: The imported file's motor digest, when it has one.

MotorImport.description:
The motor an imported file (`.ork`) named for a mount, and how
`rw import` resolved it.

oneOf.description: A curve embedded in the imported file, copied into `lib/motors/`.
A curve from the local ThrustCurve cache, copied into `lib/motors/`.

No curve was available offline: the nearest built-in generic curve
by impulse class and diameter stands in.

MotorResolution.description: How an imported motor was resolved.

visual_flow.description:
`kind = "visual_flow"`: the evaluated study (absent for flights, so
flight sims hash as before).

wind_direction_deg.description: Direction the wind blows from, clockwise from north.

gravity.description:
Gravity model. Absent: the engine default (`wgs84`). Added after the
M1.5 freeze as optional, so older files and their hashes are unchanged.

launch_into_wind.description:
Point the rod into the wind (the rod azimuth follows the wind
direction). Absent: `false`. Optional for the same reason as `gravity`.

Conditions.description:
Launch and environment conditions. Shared verbatim by `EvalSim`,
`SimInput`, `RunManifest`, and the oracle golden, so its hash
(`rw_api::oracle::conditions_hash`) identifies a setup across all of them.
Units are in the key names.

oneOf.description: ISA with custom base temperature and pressure.
Classic RK4, fixed step (parity triage, D13).
WGS84 normal gravity at the site latitude, falling off with altitude.

tank.description: Feed node id of the tank shown (`None`: the oxidizer branch's tank).

EvalVisualFlow.description: An evaluated visual flow study (`[visual_flow]` in SI, defaults applied).

oneOf.description: A scripted rocking tilt (`tilt`, `swing`, `period`) on a static stand.

AttitudeSource.description: Where a visual flow study's attitude comes from.

needs_sim.description: The rule references simulation metrics; it runs only with `--sim`.

oxidizer.description: Oxidizer and fuel ids (`n2o`, `ethanol`, or a CEA species name).

EvalEngine.description:
One liquid engine in SI (`engines/<id>.rw.toml`, M4.4). Unset inputs stay
`None` and are reported as `RW-W21x` missing inputs.

pressure_drop.description: Injector pressure drop (given, or the fraction times chamber pressure).

station.description: Centre station (the tank component's mid-length when unset).

tank.description: Resolved tank geometry (from `component` or the inline `tank`).

EvalTankSpec.description: A tank's geometry, fill, and wall material in SI.

fin_span.description: Fin span tip to tip, if any fins.

length_cal.description:
Overall length in calibers of the reference diameter
(`stability.ref_diameter`); absent without a reference diameter.

fineness.description:
Fineness ratio: overall length over the maximum body diameter; absent
without a diameter.

components.description:
The mass breakdown: each component's dry mass and CG station, in tree
order (metric paths `mass.components.<id>.mass`, `.cg`).

terms.description:
Per-component aero terms: each component's normal-force slope and CP
station, with its cited model (metric paths `aero.terms.<id>.cna`,
`.cp`). At AoA 0, `cna` is the sum of the terms' `cna` and `cp` their
CNa-weighted station.

liftoff_pct_length.description: Liftoff margin as a percent of overall length.

required.description: Required and actual value in SI of `dim`.

value.description: Evaluated left-hand value (SI); `None` when it needs `--sim` or failed.

deployment_velocity_ms.description: Speed at the last recovery deployment (the main of a dual deploy).

min_stability_cal.description: Minimum stability margin in flight (calibers), rail exit to apogee.

coast_time_s.description:
Coast from the last burnout to apogee (apogee time minus last burnout
time; the same number as `optimum_delay_s`). Absent with no burnout
before apogee.

deployments.description:
Derived timing of each recovery deployment of the main flight, in time
order (so agents never subtract event times by hand).

ejections.description:
Derived timing of each motor's ejection charge (motors with a
configured delay), by mount id.

RunSummary.description:
`summary.json`. Key-sorted, fixed significant figures (I8). Absent values
(no deployment, no delay) are omitted.

deploy_minus_apogee_s.description: Deployment time minus apogee time: negative = before apogee.

deploy_altitude_m.description: Altitude above the launch site at deployment.

DeploymentTiming.description: One recovery deployment, relative to apogee.

t_s.description: Ejection time after ignition (the motor's burnout plus its delay).

optimum_delay_s.description: Apogee time minus this motor's burnout time.

delay_minus_optimum_s.description:
Configured delay minus optimum delay (= ejection time minus apogee
time): negative = the charge fires before apogee.

EjectionTiming.description: One motor's ejection charge against its optimum delay.

legend.description:
What the render drew, as numbers: each drawn component's station
range and radial extent, and the notable relations between parts
(B3 round 12: describe a render from this, not from the picture).

RenderResult.description: The `render` tool output; the MCP reply also carries the PNG as image content.

View.description: 2D views (Rust SVG/PNG, deterministic) and 3D views (shared TS renderer).

fov_deg.description: Vertical field of view (perspective) in degrees.

relations.description: Relations between a part and the component it sits on or in.

RenderLegend.description: The text legend of a render (`rw render` prints it under the PNG path).

placement.description: How it sits in its parent (`axial` body chain, `inner`, `surface`).

count.description: Instances (fins in a set, buttons in a pattern).

r_inner.description: Innermost radius (0 for a solid on the axis; the root for fins).

LegendComponent.description: One drawn component: stations from the nose tip, radii from the body axis.

ComponentType.description: The component kind as a plain tag (`"nose_cone"`, ...).

fraction.description: 0 at `other`'s fore end, 1 at its aft end (`along`).

oneOf.description: Ends `distance` aft of `other`'s aft end (fins past the tube end).
An inner part reaching `distance` past `other`'s aft end.

A surface part (rail button, lug) centred at `station`, `fraction`
of `other`'s length from its fore end (one entry per instance).

LegendRelationKind.description: How a part relates to its parent `other`.

id.description: Motor ref usable in a config, e.g. `generic:RW_C6G`.

oneOf.description: A project `lib/motors/` file with its recorded sha256.
Embedded in an imported file (e.g. an `.rse` inside an `.ork`).
ThrustCurve.org download in the gitignored cache (parity only).
Generated by a liquid engine design (`engines/<id>.rw.toml`).

MotorSource.description: Where a curve came from (motor provenance; never OR-DB curves, S:31).

delays.description: Available ejection delays; empty = plugged only.

sha256.description: sha256 hex of the source file bytes (the motor digest).

ThrustCurve.description: A solid motor's thrust curve plus its header data.

cg.description: CG from the motor's fore end (`.rse` only).

SimulateOut.description: Returns within 100 ms: a cache hit (`Complete`, `summary` set) or a job.

RunStatus.description: Run status per sim, computed from `model_hash` (I7).

model_hash.description: Current model hash (runs with another hash are Outdated).

conditions_hash.description:
The listed run's `conditions_hash` (from its manifest): two runs with
equal hashes flew in the same environment (site, atmosphere, wind,
rail, integrator).

Provenance.description: Result provenance (I13). Visual results never feed engineering numbers.

mismatches.description:
Setup mismatches against a golden (geometry, conditions, config,
sim, motor digest). Any mismatch means rows are not scored.

phases.description:
Flight phases in time order (rail exit, burnout, apogee, the last
deployment, landing): the time, altitude, and speed of each event of
the main flight on both sides (`burnout.velocity_ms`; no apogee speed,
no landing altitude), so where the `a - b` gap opens is read from the
tool. Compared, never gated.

notes.description:
Notes on how the rows were computed (which model the static rows of a
golden diff came from, or why they are missing). Not verdicts.

unit.description:
Unit of `a`, `b`, and `delta` (`m`, `kg`, `cal`); absent for pure
numbers and unknown keys.

MetricDiffRow.description: One metric compared between two runs, versions, or a run and a golden.

ModelDiff.description: Semantic model diff keyed by component id.

unit.description:
SI unit of the field (`m`, `kg/m^3`) when a side is a quantity
literal (`"70 mm"`); `old_si`/`new_si` are those sides in that unit.

tool.description: Tool or CLI command that caused the step.

rev.description: Revision tagged at this step, e.g. `rev:07`.

HistoryStep.description: One recorded step: a snapshot-tree change (D3) in `.rw/history.git`.

StepMetrics.description:
Metrics stored per step so the history strip can draw sparklines without
re-evaluating.

marks.description:
Per-component visual-diff marks on the evaluated models (removed
red, changed amber, added green; unmarked components are unchanged).

breakdown.description:
With `breakdown`: one row per component and metric
(`mass.components.<id>.mass`, `mass.components.<id>.cg`,
`aero.terms.<id>.cna`, `aero.terms.<id>.cp`), components in `b`'s
order then those only `a` has; a side without the component has no
value. Which component a change came from is read from these rows.

fields.description: The evaluated quantities that differ (`changed` only).

ComponentMark.description:
A component marked by the visual diff, keyed by id. Unmarked components
are unchanged (drawn dimmed). A component that only moved because a part
fore of it changed length is unchanged.

MarkStatus.description:
How a component differs between two versions (the visual diff colours:
removed red, changed amber, added green).

unit.description: SI unit (`m`, `rad`); absent for pure numbers.

QuantityChange.description: One evaluated quantity that differs between two versions, in SI.

step.description: Recorded step (`None` for dry runs and edits that change nothing, D3).

imported.description: Imported component ids (`.ork`) or motor refs (motor file).

diagnostics.description:
Import findings: `RW-W010 import-approximated` (something the file
holds that RocketWright approximated or skipped) and `RW-W103
motor-substituted`.

performance.description:
Absent while the chamber inputs (area ratio or exit pressure, L*,
contraction ratio, injector drop) are missing or the thermochemistry
is unavailable. `isp_*` in seconds.

missing_inputs.description: Source pointers of unset inputs (`Missing inputs · N`).

design.description:
The full design (SI): sizing, injector, feed budget per propellant,
tanks, blowdown totals, assumptions. The feed, tank, and blowdown
parts are absent while feed inputs are missing (M4.6).

feed.description: Oxidizer then fuel feed path, when the feed inputs are complete.

assumptions.description: Modelling assumptions shown with the results (page 06 Assumptions).

ambient_pressure.description: Ambient pressure the thrust target holds at, Pa.

chamber_length.description: Cylindrical section (injector face to the start of the convergence).

total_length.description: Injector face to the exit plane.

EngineSizing.description: The thrust-chamber design at the design point (SI).

InjectorSide.description: One propellant's injector elements at the design point.

path.description: Node ids from the tank to the engine node.

required_pressure.description: Tank pressure needed: Pc + injector + lines + given valves.

margin.description: Pressure left over that no element takes (0 once a valve is sized).

resistance.description: Total resistance tank → chamber incl. the injector (ΔP = R ṁ²).

FeedBranch.description: One propellant's feed path and its design-point pressure budget (SI).

oneOf.description: An orifice edge (`bc = "orifice"`, the edge diameter).
A valve node; `area` is `None` until the budget sizes it.

FeedElement.description: One element on a feed path.

sized.description: True when the budget computed the area (no `flow_area` given).

ValveSizing.description: A valve on a path at the design point.

polytropic_exponent.description: Polytropic exponent of the ullage expansion (γ of the gas: adiabatic).

final_pressure.description: Ullage pressure once the load is gone (polytropic).

liquid_centroid.description: Liquid CG from the tank's aft inner pole.

oneOf.description: The thrust at ambient pressure fell to zero (deep over-expansion).
No chamber pressure balances the flows (a tank fell below the chamber).

step.description: Recorded step (`None` for dry runs and edits that change nothing, D3).

run_id.description:
First 12 hex of blake3 over the source files' hashes (I7); the
record is `runs/<sim>/<run_id>/cfd.json`.

files.description: Source files, project-relative when inside the project, by time.

unit.description: Unit from the `# rw-cfd: units=` line, as written (`Pa`, `K`).

ScalarRange.description: One scalar column's range over every point of the dataset's steps.
